response.justification: Strong senior-level fullstack profile that far exceeds the 6+ years requirement, with directly relevant TypeScript/Node.js/React/MongoDB/AWS experience at Optilyz and RIDE, plus current hands-on AI-agent and MCP tooling work at re:cinq — a rare and explicitly requested skill. Demonstrated testing craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD, authored test runner and assertion libraries, Selenium curriculum) aligns well with the quality and process-improvement expectations, and the internal developer-tooling focus of the role matches recent work. Main gaps are stack-specific rather than fundamental: no evidence of Nest.js or Vitest/Jest by name, limited Kotlin, and frontend depth skews Ember.js over React. Given the breadth of languages and demonstrated ability to pick up new tooling, these are likely quick ramp-ups worth probing in interview.
strengths: 15+ years fullstack across TypeScript/Node, React, MongoDB, AWS, Docker/K8s
Current AI-agent and MCP tooling experience — a hard-to-find requirement
Deep testing/TDD culture: built test runners, ran workshops, CI/CD advocate
concerns: No Nest.js or Vitest/Jest experience explicitly evidenced
Frontend depth leans Ember.js; React exposure appears secondary
Kotlin absent and relational DB (PostgreSQL) experience is thin

key_factors.factor: Depth of TypeScript/Node fullstack and cloud experience
Missing Nest.js, Vitest, and Kotlin from primary stack
